lcc_original: 上帝就按自己的形像創造人：按上帝的形像創造他：創造他們有男有女。
notes: UNV '他<WH0430>' in clause 2 refers to God (אֱלֹהִים) — LCC makes this explicit as '上帝<WH0430>'
UNV clause 2 ends with implicit '{<WAH0853>}' (Hebrew אֹתוֹ, 'him') — LCC makes the pronoun explicit as '他'; braces dropped per rule 3, giving '他<WAH0853>'

UNV clause 3 doubles '造{<WAH0853>}男...造{<WAH0853>}女' as a paraphrase; LCC consolidates into a single '創造他們有男有女' matching the Hebrew בָּרָא אֹתָם more closely — used one '創造<WH01254><WTH8804>' and resolved both implicit object markers into '他們<WAH0853>'
LCC's '有' (×2) is a Chinese existential construction with no Hebrew equivalent (זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה are simply juxtaposed in Hebrew) — left unannotated
Clause 1 '{<WAH0853>}' kept implicit: Hebrew אֶת is the object marker before הָאָדָם with no Chinese equivalent in either UNV or LCC
